home.title: Photo Size in KB: Resize for Exam Forms & Everyday Use
home.description: Make a photo, signature or PDF the exact size in KB: 20, 50, 100, 200 KB or any size. For exam forms, jobs, PAN, passport and more. Free, private.
home.hero: Photo size in KB for any form
home.heroTagline: Exam form ho ya koi aur kaam — photo, signature, sab sahi size mein.
home.heroSub: Tap the size your form asks for.
home.heroArtAlt: A 4.2 MB phone photo (3024×4032) turned into an 18.8 KB passport-size photo, 200×230 px, stamped PASS, next to a signature on white paper.
home.how1Text: Search for it. We load the official sizes from the notification.
home.how2Text: Take a photo or choose from gallery. Crop it inside the guide.
home.how3Text: Auto-fit hits the exact pixels and KB. Every rule shows a tick before you download.
home.faq1a: Yes. Every tool and exam kit is free. There is no login and no pop-up ads.
home.faq2a: No. Everything runs inside your browser on your own phone or computer. Your files are never sent to any server. After the first visit the site even works offline.
home.faq3q: Where do the sizes come from?
home.faq3a: From the exam's official notification wherever we could verify it. Sizes we could only find in secondary sources are clearly labelled “Unverified”. Every exam page links its source and shows the date we last checked it.
home.faq4a: It is the file size the form accepts. The file must be bigger than 20 KB and smaller than 50 KB. Auto-fit aims just under the top of the range, with a safety margin, so the file passes whether a portal counts 1 KB as 1000 or 1024 bytes.
home.faq5q: The portal still rejected my file. What now?
home.faq5a: Tell us on the report page with the exact error message. We re-check the notice and fix the size quickly.
home.faqArtAlt: Upload size check: an 86 KB photo is rejected because the limit is 20–50 KB. Fitted to 23 KB, the same photo passes.
home.customSpec: Any size in px, cm or mm, up to the KB you need
home.pathExamHint: Tap your exam, or search for it.
home.pathSizeHint: Pick a ready size. No exam needed.
home.faq6q: What photo upload size do PSC and sarkari forms need?
home.faq6a: There is no single size. Every exam sets its own photo and signature size in its notice, and it can change from one cycle to the next. Open your exam from the exam list for the size in its latest notice. If your exam is not listed, use the custom size tool with the pixels and KB your notice gives.
home.faq8q: How do I change a photo's size in KB?
home.faq8a: Tap a size under “Just need a size?”, such as 20, 100 or 200 KB, or open the photo size converter and type any KB. Add your photo and the file is made smaller or bigger until it lands just under that size, without stretching the picture. Exam pages do the same with the exact pixels and KB from the notice.
home.faq7a: {count} exams so far: banking (IBPS, SBI, RBI, NABARD), SSC, railways (RRB), NTA (NEET UG, JEE Main, CUET UG, UGC NET, CSIR NET), UPSC, NDA and CDS, teaching (CTET, HTET, REET), state PSC, police and India Post GDS. Each exam page shows the sizes from its official notice.
